## Checklist

- [ ] Paper is about multi-agent or swarm systems (not single-agent)

- [ ] Placed in the most fitting existing section
- [ ] Not already in the README (searched by arXiv ID and title)

- [ ] Link resolves correctly
- [ ] No unrelated changes to the README
